title: Concept: Fee waiver flag exposed
description: A fee waiver flag on a transaction or product in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The flag records a discretionary concession, so exposing it invites disputes from other customers and names the accounts that receive special treatment.
applicability: Deployments that render a fee waiver flag on a transaction or product into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The flag records a discretionary concession, so exposing it invites disputes from other customers and names the accounts that receive special treatment.
